UPDATE tbl_Endur_CommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedandNew_Archive
SET tbl_Endur_CommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedandNew_Archive.amend_reason = tbl_Endur_CommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedandNew_Staging.amend_reason,
tbl_Endur_CommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedandNew_Archive.Date_Updated = tbl_Endur_CommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedandNew_Staging.Date_Updated
FROM tbl_Endur_CommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedandNew_Archive 
JOIN ReconControl.dbo.tbl_Endur_CommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedandNew_Staging 
ON  tbl_Endur_CommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedandNew_Archive.deal_tracking_num = tbl_Endur_CommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedandNew_Staging.deal_tracking_num AND 
cast (tbl_Endur_CommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedandNew_Archive.event_date as date) = cast (tbl_Endur_CommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedandNew_Staging.event_date as date)
WHERE tbl_Endur_CommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedandNew_Archive.amend_reason IS NULL OR tbl_Endur_CommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedandNew_Archive.event_date <> tbl_Endur_CommoditiesTradeEventsAmendedandNew_Staging.amend_reason
